'''Celestial Events''' are elusive, mysterious night-sky phenomena. As of now, there exist seventeen distinct astral objects. Eight of the seventeen of the events are planets, counting Pluto. 

The {{AdvancementLink|Columbus}} is obtained by discovering half of the sixteen bodies, while the {{AdvancementLink|STOLAS}} is obtained after discovering them all (excluding Dark Days, as it is disabled by default).

== ''Behavior'' ==
Celestial Events are stellar bodies in the sky, similar to the Sun and Moon, that have a certain chance to appear in certain [[Evolution Phases]]. They revolve around Earth at different speeds, with some not even moving at all. Celestial Events cannot appear in negative Evolution Phases.

Only two Celestial Events have effects on [[Mobs|Parasites]], being Twenty-Seven and Arrow.
*Twenty-Seven will inflict all parasites that spawn with [[Rage|Rage II]] for ten minutes as long as it is active.
*Arrow will allow all parasites to drop [[Shrimp]] as long as it is active.

Added in 1.10.7, the Dark Days event (also called Celestial Displacement) can occur if enabled in the config file. It seems to have no effects on parasites, however:
*The sky will turn completely black, obscuring the Moon and all other objects in the sky.
*Sources of light, such as Torches, Glowstone, Fire, and Lava, will no longer emit light.
*There is a constant low humming.
*The Celestial Events tab in the [[Compendium]] corrupts, with every event other than Dark Days turning into [ ? ? ? ].

== ''Trivia'' ==
* The description of Venus references the song ''Mice on Venus'' by C418.
**The Mice of Venus are a very resilient species, being able to thrive in the extreme environments of Venus with its extreme temperatures and the poor atmosphere. They love '''earthly cheese'''!
*Neptune's description references the analog horror series ''Gemini Home Entertainment''.
*The Dark Days event is inspired by actual "dark days" that occur because of natural phenomena such as volcanic eruptions and other airborne debris, most notably the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_England's_Dark_Day Dark Days of New England in 1780].
*The Arrow is a reference to the mystery Warp Arrow from ''Voices of The Void''.
